experiments.experiment_label: In vivo gene editing in HemA mice using Cas9 mRNA/sgRNA LNPs
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: To target a five base pair deletion in FVIII exon 1 in a specific HemA mouse strain, we injected LNPs encapsulating Cas9 mRNA and specifically designed sgRNAs intravenously for in vivo gene editing of the mutant FVIII.
experiments.payload_or_treatment_mention: Cas9 mRNA and specifically designed sgRNAs
experiments.biological_model_mention: HemA mice (specific strain with five base pair deletion in FVIII exon 1)
experiments.distinctness_reason: Only one experimental treatment is described in the paper; all results (S05-S07) derive from this single in vivo experiment.
